narrative.overview: This system behaves like an institution's daily operations ledger: calm, information-dense surfaces with clear grouping and restrained state color. It prioritizes trust, scanning and fast completion over expressive marketing composition. Desktop pages preserve the complete business directory, while mobile surfaces concentrate on today's work.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces and one-pixel boundaries before shadows.
Blue for navigation and action, orange for pending work, red only for explicit risk.
Grouping through spacing and muted surfaces, not stacked decoration.

rules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies navigation and action, not decoration; do not wash entire page sections in the accent.

rules.name: The Information Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Type hierarchy comes from size, weight, and spacing; decorative lettering is not used for operational data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Static records stay flat. Elevation is reserved for overlays and temporary interaction surfaces.

dos: Do keep one visual center for the primary action on each page.
Do maintain at least 44px touch height with visible text labels on mobile.
Do use both text and color for pending attendance, makeups and low balances.
Do place long rules in contextual help or collapsed disclosure.
Do preserve stable tab identifiers and existing business relationships.
donts: Don't place every back-office module in the mobile bottom bar.
Don't let long course codes overpower human-readable class names and urgent status.
Don't rename the same business action differently across pages.
Don't add decorative shadows or thick colored edges to static record cards.
Don't rely on color or icons alone for errors, success or permission meaning.
